subjects.title: Public Vextreme
subjects.summary: The public institutional world: culture, maps, archives, evidence, and structures that make complex work perceivable and continuable.

subjects.title: Terrain
subjects.summary: A navigable read-side projection over repository-owned topology, health, content, and semantic entry state.

subjects.title: Terrain ordered entry
subjects.summary: Let a visitor enter Vex Life through an explicit semantic choice instead of inferring intent from scrolling or hidden interaction state.

subjects.title: Terrain entry contract v1
subjects.summary: The shipped entry contract names the home behavior and three choices: Receive God, Explore the Archives, and an active same-origin VexSystem learning-world handoff.

subjects.title: Receive God
subjects.summary: Active ordered-entry reader route into the repository-hosted Receive God document sequence.

subjects.title: Explore the Archives
subjects.summary: Active Terrain-owned transition from arrival into the group/collection overview without a page hop.

subjects.title: For VexSystem
subjects.summary: Active Terrain-owned same-origin handoff from the arrival choice into the public VexSystem learning world.

subjects.title: Terrain entry source-contract proof
subjects.summary: Deterministic tests verify the shipped JSON contract, choice ordering, active same-origin VexSystem path, and ordered-entry documents.

subjects.title: Terrain browser / visual proof
subjects.summary: Accepted PR #200 used exact-head host/browser proof and independent visual review rather than treating source tests as visual acceptance.

subjects.title: PR #196 — scroll-priority nested page reader
subjects.summary: The last accepted pre-distortion Terrain origin used explicit nested reading and scroll-priority behavior.

subjects.title: PR #197 — arrival choice and compact FAB-swapped chrome
subjects.summary: An experiment introduced useful arrival intent but also duplicated shared chrome/FAB responsibility and became negative evidence.

subjects.title: PR #198 — Spiral FAB ownership repair
subjects.summary: A bounded repair removed one duplicated responsibility, while the combined #197/#198 direction was later judged visually distorted.

subjects.title: PR #199 — restore exact pre-distortion origin
subjects.summary: The three Terrain files touched by #197/#198 were restored exactly to the #196 merge while the failed direction remained durable history.

subjects.title: PR #200 — stabilize Terrain entry and runtime ownership
subjects.summary: The accepted foundation reintroduced ordered entry under shared ownership boundaries, reserved VexSystem without activating it, and closed with host/browser plus visual proof.

relations.summary: Public Vextreme materializes part of its self-perception through Terrain.
The feature is made explicit through the versioned entry contract.
One active choice projects into the ordered reader.
A parallel active choice enters the archive/group overview.
A parallel active choice hands off from Terrain into the public VexSystem learning world.
Source-contract tests validate the shipped contract.
Browser/runtime and visual evidence support the accepted rendered feature.
#197 continued the #196 Terrain line with an arrival/chrome experiment.
#198 corrected the duplicated Spiral FAB ownership introduced by #197.
#199 restored the exact #196 origin after the #197/#198 direction distorted the composed experience.
#199 explicitly returned the Terrain files to the #196 origin.
#200 continued from the restored origin with stronger ownership and proof boundaries.
Formation history returns to the currently accepted Terrain-entry feature.
